aggregation_sumaccum.description: Executes GSQL SumAccum directly in a static single-pass pipeline without LangGraph StateGraph, classifier node, or reflection loops.
aggregation_sumaccum.scientific_hypothesis: If Static Graph + GSQL SumAccum achieves ~100% accuracy, the accuracy gain is driven by in-database GSQL computation rather than agentic orchestration.
aggregation_sumaccum.interpretation: Empirically proves that in-database GSQL SumAccum drives 100% of the gain (100.0% vs baseline 4.8%); agentic orchestration is unnecessary.

superlative_heapaccum.description: Executes GSQL HeapAccum(1) directly in a static single-pass pipeline without LangGraph StateGraph or reflection loops.
superlative_heapaccum.scientific_hypothesis: If Static Graph + HeapAccum achieves ~100% accuracy, extreme ranking is solved entirely by the priority queue accumulator.
superlative_heapaccum.interpretation: Ablated pipeline achieved 80.0%. LangGraph orchestration contributes 20.0% beyond HeapAccum.

multihop_datespan.description: Executes graph traversal with deterministic date-span overlap ranking to resolve venue collisions, but disables vector fallback and reflection.
multihop_datespan.scientific_hypothesis: Measures what fraction of multi-hop improvement is explained by deterministic date matching vs adaptive fallback retrieval.
multihop_datespan.interpretation: Deterministic date-span overlap resolves venue collisions, lifting accuracy from 53.6% to 92.9%. The remaining gap to 96.4% requires vector fallback.

multihop_vector_fallback.description: Executes graph traversal with targeted vector fallback on gap, but allows only 1 single pass without iterative Self-RAG reflection loops.
multihop_vector_fallback.scientific_hypothesis: Measures whether single-pass fallback suffices or if multi-turn self-reflection is required to resolve multi-hop entities.
multihop_vector_fallback.interpretation: Single-pass vector fallback recovers corpus gaps, achieving 85.7%. Iterative Self-RAG reflection accounts for the final 10.7% margin.
